summary: A slide rejected after authoring because its HTML does not carry the source it was given fails that slide's author stage retryably, so the retry re-authors only that slide instead of discarding the deck.
invariants: The rejection is recorded with fail_stage(stage="author"), which clears the slide's completed status and stores the reason.
The stored reason becomes the slide's correction hint on the next attempt.
Slides already authored keep their checkpoints and are not re-authored.
The deck still fails when the retries are exhausted; nothing is published with source text missing.
Total provider calls stay bounded by the operation's max_attempts and the per-attempt ordinal pair.
forbidden: End a deck on one slide's source-binding rejection while the other slides are authored and durable.
Publish a deck whose source text a slide never rendered.
rationale: Operation 612d4b75 authored all 35 slides and lost every one of them because slide 28 omitted '장기고객 만들기' from a header it was told to copy verbatim.
Stamping already detects this per slide at the author stage, so the slide is the natural unit of the failure; only the retryable flag stood between that and a one-slide redo.
Completes the pair authored.provider-attempt-budget-per-operation-attempt (the retry can call the provider) and authored.retry-carries-prior-failure-correction (it knows what to fix).
